paragraphs: Magnite, Inc., ("we," or "us"), provides technology solutions to automate the purchase and sale of digital advertising inventory.

We believe that we are the world's largest independent omni-channel sell-side advertising platform ("SSP"), offering a single partner for transacting globally across all channels, formats and auction types, and the largest independent programmatic CTV marketplace, making it easier for buyers to reach CTV audiences at scale from industry-leading streaming content providers, broadcasters, platforms and device manufacturers.

Our platform features applications and services for sellers of digital advertising inventory, or publishers, that own and operate CTV channels, applications, websites and other digital media properties, to manage and monetize their inventory; applications and services for buyers, including advertisers, agencies, agency trading desks, and demand side platforms ("DSPs"), to buy digital advertising inventory; and a transparent, independent marketplace that brings buyers and sellers together and facilitates intelligent decision making and automated transaction execution at scale. Our clients include many of the world's leading buyers and sellers of digital advertising inventory. Our platform processes trillions of ad requests per month, allowing buyers access to a global, scaled, independent alternative to "walled gardens," who both own and sell inventory and maintain control on the demand side.

Our SpringServe CTV platform offers CTV sellers a holistic solution to manage and monetize their entire portfolio of CTV ad inventory, across both programmatic and direct-sold video inventory. We provide sellers with a full suite of tools to protect the consumer viewing experience and brand safety expectations, while increasing revenue opportunities, including tools for mediation and yield optimization, forecasting tools, customized ad experiences and ad formats, and advanced podding logic. These tools are particularly important to CTV sellers who need to provide a TV-like viewing and advertising experience for consumers. For instance, our ad-pod feature provides publishers with a tool analogous to commercial breaks in traditional linear television so that they can request and manage several ads at once from different demand sources. Other tools we offer include audio normalization tools to control for the volume of an ad relative to content, frequency capping to avoid exposing viewers to repetitive ad placements, and creative review so that a publisher can review and approve the ad units being served to its properties.

Buyers leverage our platform to reach their target audiences across thousands of sellers in a premium brand-safe environment. We offer a suite of tools designed to help buyers discover and curate inventory, simplify workflow and execute on their campaign objectives in a cost effective manner. For instance, our ClearLine product provides buyers with direct access to premium CTV inventory and integrated curation capabilities, enabling buyers to build custom deal packages that can be enriched with high-fidelity first-party or third-party data. We believe that our scale, platform features, and omni-channel offering makes us an essential partner for buyers.

We operate our business on a worldwide basis, with an established operating presence in North America, Australia and Europe, and a developing presence in Asia and South America. Our non-U.S. subsidiaries and operations perform primarily sales, marketing, and service functions.

Consumers are rapidly shifting their viewing habits towards digital mediums and expect to be able to consume content seamlessly across multiple devices, including computers, tablets, smartphones, and CTVs whenever and wherever they want. As digital content consumption continues to proliferate, we believe the percentage of advertising dollars spent through digital channels will continue to grow.

Due to the size and complexity of the digital advertising ecosystem and purchasing process, manual processes cannot effectively manage digital advertising inventory at scale. In addition, both buyers and sellers are demanding more transparency, better controls and more relevant insights from their advertising inventory purchases and sales. This has created a need for software solutions, known as programmatic advertising, that automate the process for planning, buying, selling and measuring digital advertising across screens. Programmatic transactions include biddable auctions, where multiple buyers bid against each other in a real-time auction for the right to purchase a publisher's inventory, as well as reserve auctions, where publishers

establish direct deals or private marketplaces with select buyers. These reserve auctions may also be "guaranteed," where a buyer has negotiated a pre-established price and volume with a seller, otherwise referred to as "programmatic guaranteed."

CTV viewership is growing rapidly and the pace of adoption is accelerating the transition of linear television to CTV programming. Initially, many streaming services were subscription based, but as the market has matured, the largest streaming publishers have adopted ad-supported models or hybrid models that rely on a combination of subscription fees and advertising. With the proliferation of CTV advertising inventory, we believe that brand advertisers looking to engage with streaming viewers will continue to shift their budgets from linear to CTV. Moreover, we believe that as the amount of CTV inventory continues to scale, it will become increasingly more accessible to small and medium sized businesses, many of whom have no experience advertising on linear TV. This transition is likely to be accelerated by advancements in AI, which have simplified the process and reduced the cost of producing TV-ready ad creatives. As the advertiser base for CTV expands and diversifies, we believe CTV sellers will make a greater percentage of inventory available through biddable auction environments with multiple buyers rather than programmatic guaranteed. We believe that this shift, if it were to occur, would likely be beneficial to our CTV growth as biddable transactions tend to require a higher level of service and therefore carry a higher take-rate compared to reserve auctions.

We have made and plan to continue to make significant investments in technology, sales and support related to our CTV growth initiatives, and believe CTV will be a significant driver of our revenue growth for the foreseeable future. In April 2025, we announced the introduction of our next generation SpringServe CTV platform. The new SpringServe platform combines the features and functionalities of our streaming SSP and ad server to provide a more efficient connection for buyers to premium CTV supply, while offering powerful mediation tools and streamlined workflow for sellers through a single user interface.

One of the advantages of programmatic advertising is that it enables more precise audience targeting, which is generally more effective and valuable for buyers than other types of advertising, resulting in better performance for buyers and more revenue for sellers. Historically, in desktop and mobile, one of the primary methods for delivering targeted advertisements was through the use of third-party cookies. However, in recent years the use of third-party cookies and other tracking technologies that collect user information have come under greater scrutiny due to privacy concerns, and a number of participants in the advertising technology ecosystem have taken steps to eliminate or restrict the use of these technologies.

In the long term, we believe that a decreased reliance on third-party cookies and other non-transparent tracking methods would be a positive for the industry, and offer the potential to shift the programmatic ecosystem from an identity model powered by buyers that are able to aggregate and target audiences through cookies to one enabled by sellers that have direct relationships with consumers and are therefore better positioned to obtain user data and consent for implementing first party identifiers. In CTV, where third-party cookies do not exist, this identity model already largely exists with publishers more tightly controlling access to identifiers and user data, while offering proprietary first party data segments for reaching desired audiences.

We believe that our scale and expertise in CTV position us well to take a leadership position in advancing this shift to a first-party identity model and creating additional value opportunities for our clients. Accordingly, we have invested and intend to further invest in the development and enhancement of industry leading identity and audience solutions, such as our Magnite Curator Marketplace, a self-service solution integrated within ClearLine. The Magnite Curator Marketplace allows the creation of custom deal packages for buyers that include curated pools of premium inventory that can be enriched with the curator's first-party or third-party data.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business, Growth Prospects and Operating Results
We operate in an intensely competitive market that includes companies that have greater financial, technical and marketing resources than we do.
If CTV advertising spend grows more slowly than we expect, or growth occurs disproportionately through platforms that we cannot access, our operating results and growth prospects could be harmed.
Programmatic advertising presents unique challenges for CTV sellers, and CTV sellers may not adopt or may be slow to adopt programmatic solutions that transact in biddable auction environments.
The digital advertising market, and our business, may be negatively impacted by advancements in AI.
AI may significantly affect the competitive dynamics of our industry, and failure to effectively build AI features into our platform could adversely affect our results of operations.
We may be ineffective in using AI to realize internal efficiencies, which could result in higher operating costs and decreased margins.
The regulatory landscape governing AI is still developing, and our use of third party AI tools may result in increased legal and regulatory scrutiny, litigation, and reputational harm.
We may be unsuccessful in our Supply Path Optimization efforts.
Our technology development efforts may be inefficient or ineffective, which may impair our ability to attract buyers and sellers.
We must increase the scale and efficiency of our technology infrastructure to support our growth and transaction volumes.
The emergence of header bidding has increased competition from other demand sources and may cause infrastructure strain and added cost.
To the extent our access to mobile inventory is limited by third-party technology or lack of direct relationships with mobile sellers, our ability to grow our business will be impaired.
Fee issues have in the past and could in the future have a material adverse effect on our business.
We have a history of losses and we face many risks that may prevent us from achieving or sustaining profitability in the future.
Our business and the businesses of our advertiser clients may be subject to sales and use tax, value-added/goods and services, advertising, digital services, withholding and other taxes.
As a result of various factors, our operating results have in the past and may in the future fluctuate significantly, be difficult to predict, and fall below analysts' and investors' expectations.
We must provide value to both buyers and sellers of advertising without being perceived as favoring one over the other or being perceived as competing with them through our service offerings.
Our sales efforts with buyers and sellers may require significant time and expense and may not yield the results we seek.

paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk, including the risks described below, each of which may be relevant to decisions regarding an investment in or ownership of our stock. The occurrence of any of these risks could have a significant adverse effect on our reputation, business, financial condition, revenue, results of operations, growth, or ability to accomplish our strategic objectives, and could cause the trading price of our common stock to decline. You should carefully consider the risks set forth below and the other information contained in this report, including our consolidated financial statements and related notes and Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, before making investment decisions related to our common stock. However, this report cannot anticipate and fully address all possible risks of investing in our common stock, the risks of investing in our common stock may change over time, and additional risks and uncertainties that we are not aware of, or that we do not consider to be material, may emerge. Moreover, some of the factors, events, and contingencies discussed below may have occurred in the past. References to past events are provided by way of example only and are not intended to be a complete listing or representation as to whether or not such events have occurred in the past or their likelihood of occurring in the future, and instead reflect our beliefs and opinions as to the factors, events, or contingencies that could materially and adversely affect us in the future. Accordingly, you are advised to consider additional sources of information and exercise your own judgment in addition to the information we provide.

Our revenue and operating results are highly dependent on the overall demand for advertising and any macroeconomic challenges may adversely affect our business, financial position, results of operations and/or cash flows.

Our business depends on the overall demand for advertising and on the economic health of our current and prospective sellers and buyers. If advertisers reduce their overall advertising spending, our revenue and results of operations are directly affected. Accordingly, our business and operations have been, and could in the future be, adversely affected by events beyond our control, such as health epidemics or pandemics, geopolitical events, and economic and macroeconomic factors like labor strikes, labor shortages, supply chain disruptions, tariffs, trade wars, capital market disruptions and instability of financial institutions, inflation and recessionary concerns impacting the markets and communities in which our clients operate.

In addition, continued inflation could result in an increase in our cost base relative to our revenue and increased cost associated with our infrastructure investments. Moreover, in response to US tariffs, foreign countries in which we operate may enact additional or new taxes that are applicable to our business.
Any worsening of macroeconomic conditions in future periods would likely have a negative effect on our financial results, the magnitude of which is difficult to predict.

We face intense competition in the marketplace. We compete for advertising spending against competitors that, in some cases, are also buyers and/or sellers on our platform. We also compete for supply of advertising inventory against a variety of competitors. Some of our existing and potential competitors are better established, benefit from greater name recognition, may have offerings and technology that we do not have or have significantly more financial, technical, sales, and marketing resources than we do. In addition, some competitors, particularly those with greater scale or a more diversified revenue base and a broader offering, have greater flexibility than we do to compete aggressively on the basis of price and other contract terms, or to compete with us by including in their product offerings services that we may not provide. Some existing and potential buyers that we work with have their own direct relationships with sellers or are seeking to establish such relationships, and many sellers are investing in capabilities that enable them to connect more effectively directly with buyers without the use of intermediaries such as us. Our business suffers to the extent that buyers and sellers purchase and sell advertising inventory directly from one another or through intermediaries other than us, reducing the amount of advertising spend on our platform. New or stronger competitors may emerge through acquisitions and industry consolidation or through development of disruptive technologies, including artificial intelligence ("AI"), which may disrupt the digital advertising ecosystem by enabling new ad-buying, optimization or monetization models or enhancing the capabilities of competitors. If our offerings are not perceived as competitively differentiated, we could lose clients, market share or be compelled to reduce our prices, making it more difficult to grow our business profitably.

Over the past several years, we have made a number of investments to build what we believe is the leading independent programmatic CTV platform, including our 2021 acquisitions of SpotX, a leading CTV supply side platform, and SpringServe, a leading ad server for CTV. We believe these transactions are highly strategic, as the combination of our SSP and ad server allows us to offer publishers an independent full-stack solution that works across their entire video advertising business, for both programmatic and directly sold inventory, to manage yield and drive value. As a result of our investments, CTV has become the biggest growth driver of our business, with revenue growing 9% and Contribution ex-TAC growing 17% year-over-year from 2024 to 2025.

We believe that we are well positioned to take advantage of a number of favorable market trends in CTV. In particular, as the pace of adoption has accelerated and the streaming market has proliferated, the largest streaming publishers have adopted ad-supported models leading to a significant increase in the amount of CTV inventory available for advertisers.

Despite the proliferation of CTV advertising inventory, CTV sellers have been slower to embrace biddable environments with multiple buyers compared to desktop and mobile sellers. Currently, the vast majority of CTV advertising is transacted through reserve auctions that are established by a sellers direct sales team with a single buyer. This is particularly true of larger publishers and broadcasters that are newer to programmatic advertising and have large direct sales forces, as reserve auctions allow the seller to maintain tighter control over their advertising allocation. These publishers have continued to increase their focus and investment in programmatic CTV, and in recent periods have grown as a percentage of our CTV business.

As the industry matures, we anticipate that market dynamics will lead CTV sellers to make a greater percentage of inventory available through biddable auction environments with multiple buyers rather than programmatic guaranteed, in order to accommodate a broader set of advertisers that have not historically advertised on linear TV. We believe that this shift, if it were to occur, would likely be beneficial to our CTV growth as biddable transactions tend to require a higher level of service and therefore carry a higher take-rate compared to reserve auctions. At the same time, we expect CTV advertisers that have historically transacted on our platform through managed service insertion orders to continue to shift budgets towards more automated solutions, which tend
to carry a lower take rate; and as a result, we expect transactions through managed service insertion orders to become a smaller component of our overall business.

We have made and plan to continue to make significant investments in technology, sales and support related to our CTV growth initiatives, and believe CTV will be a significant driver of our revenue growth for the foreseeable future. In April 2025, we announced the introduction of our next generation SpringServe CTV platform. The new SpringServe platform combines the features and functionalities of our streaming SSP and ad server to provide a more efficient connection for buyers to premium CTV supply, while offering powerful tools and streamlined workflow for sellers through a single user interface.

In addition to CTV, we track mobile and desktop channels. We expect our revenue and Contribution ex-TAC from each of these channels to grow at a slower rate compared to CTV, with mobile expected to grow at a higher rate than desktop. In particular, we believe growth rates for open web display will be lower across both mobile and desktop, consistent with the overall decline in search referral traffic. We expect our desktop and mobile web business to continue to decline as an overall percentage of our revenue in future periods; however, we expect that contributions from these channels will continue to represent a significant percentage of our revenue in the near term. Therefore, the mix of our desktop and mobile web business will continue to have a negative effect on our overall growth rate.

paragraphs: Magnite, Inc., ("we," or "us"), 提供科技解決方案以自動化數位廣告存貨的購買與銷售。
我們認為我們是全球最大的獨立全通路賣方廣告平台 ("SSP")，提供一個單一合作夥伴，可在全球各通路、格式及拍賣類型進行交易，並為最大的獨立程序化 CTV 市場，使買方更容易從行業領先的串流內容供應商、廣播電臺、平台及裝置製造商，大規模接觸 CTV 受眾。

我們的平台提供應用程式與服務，協助數位廣告存貨賣方 (即發行商)，擁有並運營 CTV 頻道、應用程式、網站及其他數位媒體資產，以管理與 monetize 其存貨；應用程式與服務，協助買方，包括廣告主、代理商、代理商交易桌及需求端平台 ("DSPs")，以購買數位廣告存貨；以及一個透明、獨立的市場平台，將買方與賣方結合，並促進智能決策與大規模自動交易執行。我們的客戶包括許多全球知名的數位廣告存貨買方與賣方。我們的平台每月處理數兆個廣告請求，使買方能存取全球規模化、獨立的替代方案，以對抗擁有並銷售存貨且控制需求端的 "壁壘園區"。

我們的 SpringServe CTV 平台為 CTV 廣告存貨賣方提供一套完整的解決方案，以管理與 monetize 其全部 CTV 廣告存貨，涵蓋程序化與直接銷售的視訊存貨。我們為賣方提供完整的工具組，以保護消費者觀看體驗與品牌安全期待，同時增加收入機會，包括中介與收益最佳化工具、預測工具、客製化廣告體驗與格式，以及先進的 Pod 設計邏輯。這些工具對需要為消費者提供類似傳統線性電視觀看與廣告體驗的 CTV 廣告存貨賣方而言尤其重要。例如，我們的廣告 Pod 功能為發行商提供類似傳統線性電視商業間隔的工具，使其能同時請求並管理來自不同需求來源的多個廣告。我們提供的其他工具包括音量控制工具，以控制廣告音量相對於內容的音量，頻率上限控制以避免讓觀眾接觸重複的廣告投放，以及創意審核功能，使發行商能審核並批准投放至其資產的廣告單元。
買方利用我們的平台，在數千個賣方中接觸其目標受眾，並在高品質品牌安全環境中進行操作。我們提供一套工具，協助買方發現與整理存貨、簡化工作流程並以成本效益的方式執行其行銷目標。例如，我們的 ClearLine 產品為買方提供直接存取高品質 CTV 存貨的管道，並整合整理功能，使買方能建立客製化交易組合，並可加入高忠實度的第一方或第三方資料。
我們在全球範圍內運營業務，並在北美、澳洲與歐洲擁有已建立的運營據點，而在亞洲與南美洲則處於發展階段。我們的非美國子公司與運營據點主要執行銷售、行銷與服務功能。
消費者正迅速轉向數位媒介進行觀看習慣，並期待能在多種裝置上無縫串流內容，包括電腦、平板電腦、智慧型手機及 CTV，無論何時何地。隨著數位內容消費持續增加，我們認為透過數位渠道支出的廣告金額比例將持續成長。
由於數位廣告生態系統與購買流程的規模與複雜性，手動流程無法有效管理數位廣告存貨。此外，買方與賣方均要求更高的透明度、更好的控制與更相關的洞察力。這已創造出一種軟體解決方案的需求，稱為程序化廣告，用以自動化規劃、購買、銷售與衡量跨螢幕的數位廣告流程。程序化交易包括競價拍賣，多個買方在實時拍賣中競價以取得發行商的存貨權利，以及保留拍賣，發行商
建立與特定買方的直接協議或私人市場場地。這些保留拍賣也可能被稱為『保證』，買方已與賣方協商好預設價格與交易量，否則稱為『程序化保證』。

CTV 觀看人數正在快速成長，採用速度加快，促使線性電視轉向 CTV 節目。起初，許多串流服務為訂閱制，但隨著市場成熟，最大的串流發行商已採用廣告支持模式或混合模式，依賴訂閱費與廣告的組合。隨著 CTV 廣告存貨的增加，我們認為品牌廣告商想要與串流觀眾互動，將持續將預算從線性轉向 CTV。此外，我們認為隨著 CTV 存貨持續擴張，將越來越容易讓中小企業使用，許多企業尚未有在線性電視廣告的經驗。此轉變將可能因人工智能的進步而加速，這些進步簡化了製作電視合適廣告創意的過程並降低成本。隨著 CTV 廣告商的基礎擴大且多元化，我們認為 CTV 廣告商將提供更多存貨透過可競價拍賣環境供多個買方使用，而非程序化保證。我們認為如果這種轉變發生，將對我們的 CTV 成長有益，因為可競價交易通常需要較高的服務水平，因此取成率較高，與保留拍賣相比。
我們已投入並計畫持續投入大量資源於與 CTV 成長計畫相關的科技、銷售與支援，我們認為 CTV 將是我們可預見未來營收成長的重要驅動力。2025 年 4 月，我們宣佈推出新一代的 SpringServe CTV 平台。新的 SpringServe 平台結合我們串流 SSP 與廣告伺服器的功能，提供買方更高效的連接至高品質 CTV 存貨，同時透過單一使用者介面提供強大的中介工具與簡化的工作流程。
程序化廣告的一個優勢是它能實現更精準的受眾定位，這通常對買方而言比其他類型的廣告更有效且更有價值，導致買方表現更佳，賣方收入更多。歷史來看，在桌面與行動裝置上，主要的目標廣告投放方法是透過第三方 Cookie。然而，近年來，第三方 Cookie 及其他收集用戶資訊的追蹤技術受到更多關注，因隱私問題而受到質疑，許多廣告科技生態系參與者已採取措施消除或限制這些技術的使用。

長期來看，我們認為減少對第三方 Cookie 及其他非透明追蹤方法的依賴將對產業有益，並有潛力將程序化生態系從由買方透過 Cookie 積累與定位受眾的身分模型，轉向由賣方直接與消費者建立關係，因此更適合取得用戶資料與同意，以實現第一方身分識別的模型。在 CTV 中，第三方 Cookie 並不存在，此身分模型已廣泛存在，發行商更嚴格控制對識別符與用戶資料的存取，同時提供專屬的第一方資料段以觸及目標受眾。

我們認為我們在 CTV 的規模與專業知識，使我們能領導推動此轉變至第一方身分模型，並為客戶創造額外價值機會。因此，我們已投資並計畫進一步投資於行業領先的身分與受眾解決方案的開發與提升，例如我們的 Magnite Curator Marketplace，這是一個整合於 ClearLine 的自服務解決方案。Magnite Curator Marketplace 允許買方建立自訂交易包，包含經過策劃的高品質存貨池，可與策劃者的第一方或第三方資料結合以豐富資料。

headings: 關鍵營運及財務績效指標
{'Liquidity and Capital Resources': '流動性及資金來源'}
paragraphs: 您應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，並配合本年度10-K表報中包含於第8項的合併財務報表及其相關附註。除了歷史財務資訊外，下列討論包含向前看的陳述，反映我們的計畫、預估、信念與預期，並涉及風險與不確定性。我們的實際結果與事件的時間點可能與這些向前看的陳述有重大差異。導致這些差異的因素包括下列所討論的，以及本年度10-K表報中其他處所提及的，特別是在「第1A項 風險因素」及「向前看陳述特別說明；風險因素摘要」中所提及的。
請參閱「第1項 事業」以瞭解我們的業務、所處產業及重要的產業趨勢。
以下為我們截至2025年12月31日、2024年12月31日及2023年12月31日的合併財務重點：
財務指標及非GAAP財務指標：營業收入 713,953 668,170 619,710 7 % 8 %
* 貢獻扣除TAC及調整後EBITDA為非GAAP指標。請參閱「關鍵營運與財務績效指標」部分，以瞭解貢獻扣除TAC及調整後EBITDA的定義，以及2025年12月31日、2024年12月31日及2023年12月31日的毛利至貢獻扣除TAC及淨收入（虧損）至調整後EBITDA的調整說明。

過去幾年，我們已進行多項投資，以建立我們認為為領先的獨立程式化CTV平台，包括我們於2021年收購的SpotX，為領先的CTV供應端平台，以及SpringServe，為領先的CTV廣告伺服器。我們認為這些交易具有高度戰略意義，因為我們的SSP與廣告伺服器組合，使我們能為發行商提供一個獨立的完整解決方案，適用於其整個視訊廣告業務，無論是程式化或直接銷售的存貨，以管理收益並推動價值。由於我們的投資，CTV已成為我們業務最大的成長動力，2024年至2025年，營業收入成長9%，貢獻扣除TAC成長17%。
我們認為我們在CTV領域擁有良好的優勢，可利用多項有利的市場趨勢。特別是，隨著採用速度加快且串流市場持續擴張，最大的串流發行商已採用廣告支援模式，導致可供廣告主使用的CTV存貨大幅增加。

儘管CTV廣告存貨已大幅增加，但CTV賣方對採用可競價環境與多個買家的接受度仍較桌面及行動賣方為慢。目前，絕大多數的CTV廣告交易仍透過賣方直接銷售團隊與單一買家建立的保留拍賣進行。這一點在較大型的發行商與廣播公司尤其明顯，這些公司較新進入程序化廣告領域，且擁有龐大的直接銷售團隊，保留拍賣使賣方能更嚴格控制其廣告分配。這些發行商持續增加對程序化CTV的關注與投資，且在近期期間，程序化CTV業務在本公司CTV業務中所佔比例已逐步提高。

隨著產業成熟，我們預期市場動態將促使CTV賣方提高透過可競價拍賣環境與多個買家進行交易的存貨比例，而非程序化保證交易，以適應較廣泛的廣告主羣體，這些廣告主歷來較少在線性電視上進行廣告投放。我們認為，若此轉變發生，將對本公司CTV成長產生正面影響，因為可競價交易通常需要較高的服務水準，因此取成率較保留拍賣為高。同時，我們預期那些歷來透過本公司平台透過管理服務插入訂單進行交易的CTV廣告主，將持續將預算轉向更多自動化解決方案，這些解決方案
以攜帶較低的抽成率；且因此，我們預期透過管理服務插入訂單的交易將成為我們整體業務中較小的零組件。

我們已進行並計畫持續進行重大投資於與我們CTV成長計畫相關的技術、銷售及支援領域，且我們認為CTV將是我們營業收入成長的重要驅動因素，至少在可預見的未來。2025年4月，我們宣佈推出我們下一代的SpringServe CTV平台。新的SpringServe平台結合我們串流SSP與廣告伺服器的特色與功能，以提供買家更高效的連接至高價值CTV供應，同時透過單一使用者介面，為賣家提供強大的工具與簡化的工作流程。

除了CTV，我們也追蹤行動與桌面通路。我們預期來自這些通路的營業收入與扣除TAC後的貢獻將以較慢的速率成長，相比CTV，其中行動通路預期成長速率將高於桌面通路。特別是，我們認為開放網頁展示的成長速率在行動與桌面通路中將均較低，與總體搜尋導向流量的下降趨勢一致。我們預期我們的桌面與行動網頁業務將持續以整體營收百分比的形態下降；然而，我們預期這些通路的貢獻將持續代表我們營收的重要百分比，在近期內。因此，我們的桌面與行動網頁業務組成將持續對我們整體成長速率產生負面影響。

headings: 與本公司業務、成長前景及營運結果相關之風險
本公司營運於一高度競爭之市場，其中包括擁有較本公司更優越財務、技術及行銷資源之公司。
若CTV廣告支出成長速度低於本公司預期，或成長主要透過本公司無法接觸之平台發生，則本公司營運結果及成長前景可能受損。
程序化廣告對CTV賣方而言，帶來獨特之挑戰，且CTV賣方可能未採用或延遲採用於競價拍賣環境中進行交易之程序化解決方案。
數位廣告市場，以及本公司業務，可能因人工智能（AI）之進步而受到負面影響。
人工智能（AI）可能顯著影響本公司產業之競爭態勢，若未能有效將AI功能整合至本公司平台，可能對本公司營運結果造成不利影響。
本公司可能無法有效運用AI以實現內部效率，此可能導致營運成本增加及毛利下降。
規範人工智能（AI）之法規環境仍在發展中，本公司使用第三方AI工具可能導致法律及法規監管增加、訴訟及聲譽損害。
我們可能無法成功實現供應鏈優化計畫。
我們的技術開發計畫可能效率低下或效果不佳，這可能會影響我們吸引買家與賣家的能力。
我們必須提升技術基礎設施的規模與效率，以支撐我們的成長與交易量。
標頭競標（header bidding）的出現增加了來自其他需求來源的競爭，並可能導致基礎設施負荷增加與額外成本。
倘若我們的行動存貨存取受到第三方技術或缺乏與行動賣家直接關係的限制，將會影響我們業務的成長能力。
費用問題過去曾對我們的業務產生重大不利影響，未來亦可能如此。
我們有虧損的歷史，且面臨許多風險，這些風險可能阻止我們實現或維持未來的獲利能力。
我們的業務以及我們廣告客戶的業務可能需承擔銷售與使用稅、增值/貨物與服務稅、廣告稅、數位服務稅、扣繳稅及其他稅務。
由於各種因素，我們的營運成果過去曾並可能未來大幅波動，難以預測，且可能低於分析師與投資人的預期。
我們必須在不被視為偏袒任一方或被視為透過服務方案與其競爭的情況下，為廣告買方與賣方提供價值。
我們與買方及賣方的銷售努力可能需要大量時間與費用，且可能無法達到我們所追求的結果。
與我們資料的蒐集、使用及揭露相關的風險
paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及高度風險，包括下列所列風險，這些風險可能與有關投資本公司股票或持有本公司股票的決定相關。上述任何風險的發生，可能對本公司聲譽、業務、財務狀況、營業收入、營運結果、成長或達成戰略目標的能力產生重大不利影響，並可能導致本公司普通股的交易價格下跌。您應仔細考慮下列所列風險及其他本報告中所包含的資訊，包括本公司合併財務報表及其相關附註，以及管理層對財務狀況與營運結果的討論與分析，以做出有關本公司普通股的投資決策。然而，本報告無法預見並完全解決所有可能的投資風險，投資本公司普通股的風險可能隨時間而改變，且可能出現我們未察覺或認為不具重大性的其他風險與不確定性。此外，下列所討論的一些因素、事件與待決事項可能已發生在過去。提及過去事件僅為範例，並非完整列出或表示這些事件是否曾發生過或其未來發生的可能性，而是反映我們對可能對本公司未來產生重大且不利影響的因素、事件或待決事項的觀點與看法。因此，您應考慮其他資訊來源並自行判斷，除了我們所提供的資訊之外。
本公司營業收入與營運結果高度依賴廣告總體需求，任何總體經濟挑戰可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果及/或現金流產生不利影響。
本公司業務依賴廣告總體需求及我們現有與潛在買方與賣方的經濟狀況。若廣告商減少總體廣告支出，將直接影響本公司營業收入與營運結果。因此，本公司業務與營運已受到、且未來可能受到我們無法控制的事件影響，例如健康疫情或大流行、地緣政治事件，以及勞工罷工、勞工短缺、供應鏈中斷、關稅、貿易戰、資本市場中斷與金融機構不穩定、通貨膨脹及經濟衰退憂慮，這些因素可能影響我們客戶所經營的市場與社區。
此外，持續通貨膨脹可能導致我們的成本基礎相對於營業收入增加，並增加與基礎建設投資相關的成本。此外，為回應美國關稅，我們營運的外國國家可能針對我們業務課徵額外或新的稅收。
未來任何總體經濟狀況惡化，將可能對我們財務結果產生負面影響，其影響程度難以預測。

我們在市場上面臨強烈競爭。我們與競爭對手爭取廣告支出，這些競爭對手在某些情況下也是我們平台的買方與/或賣方。我們也與多種競爭對手爭取廣告存貨供應。我們的一些現有與潛在競爭對手已建立較佳聲譽，可能擁有我們所沒有或擁有顯著更多財務、技術、銷售與行銷資源。此外，一些競爭對手，特別是那些規模較大或擁有更廣泛收入來源與更廣泛產品組合的競爭對手，擁有比我們更大的靈活性，可在價格及其他合約條款上進行更具侵略性的競爭，或透過在其產品組閤中包含我們可能不提供的服務來與我們競爭。我們合作的一些現有與潛在買方已與賣方建立直接關係，或正在尋求建立這樣的關係，許多賣方正在投資於能使其無需中介機構如我們即可更有效地與買方連接的技術能力。我們的業務受到影響的程度，取決於買方與賣方是否直接從彼此處購買與銷售廣告存貨，或透過除我們以外的中介機構進行交易，這會減少在我們平台上的廣告支出。新興或更強大的競爭對手可能透過收購與產業整合或透過發展顛覆性技術（包括人工智慧（"AI"））出現，這些技術可能透過啟動新的廣告購買、最佳化或 monetization 模式，或增強競爭對手的能力，來顛覆數位廣告生態系統。若我們的產品與服務未被視為具有競爭性差異，我們可能失去客戶、市場佔有率，或被迫降低價格，使我們更難以實現盈利成長。
